recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No follow-up source work is needed for this issue unless FM opens a new tracker to revisit the existing element locations or wording.
issue_request: FHIR-11396 asked for a 0..1 boolean negation indicator on ExplanationOfBenefit benefits to show a benefit is not covered, and the Published/Persuasive resolution said to add it to EligibilityResponse and EOB.
initial_application: No commit message explicitly names FHIR-11396, but d1be564fe0a5fed4f38a2dbb1b4f5fc16f106a20 added excluded rows to the legacy EligibilityResponse and ExplanationOfBenefit spreadsheets, and 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 migrated the same semantics into current StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini makes CoverageEligibilityResponse and ExplanationOfBenefit active resources and maps the old EligibilityResponse name to CoverageEligibilityResponse. Corrected Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting decision about these excluded benefit indicators.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. ExplanationOfBenefit.benefitBalance.excluded and CoverageEligibilityResponse.insurance.item.excluded are both 0..1 boolean elements with definitions saying true means the class/product/service is excluded from the plan and missing/false means it is included in coverage.
